blocks.text: Metrotown homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Metrotown, September 2026. Detached houses: 14 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 50% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 341 listed at month end and 35 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 16 sold over 4 months against an average of 15.8 listed, about 3.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 191 sold over 4 months against an average of 352.5 listed, about 7.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 57 sold.
